interfaces.name: yaw_horn_top
interfaces.what: Ø18 disc + Ø16 x 1.9 boss face with Ø6 centre bore and 4 x Ø2.2 on a Ø12 bolt circle at 0/90/180/270 deg, counterbored Ø4.4 from below — the head-yaw XL330 (hung in yaw_roll_motion above) bolts its horn here; the yaw axis is mesh +z through (0,0)
interfaces.source: MEASURED off Pollen's mesh by cecad.meshfeatures (boss Ø16 len 1.9 at z -11.05, disc Ø18 len 1.0 at z -12.5, holes residual 0.000) + meshslice probes, 2026-09-02

interfaces.name: yaw_bearing_seat
interfaces.what: the same Ø16.0 x 1.9 boss as inner-race seat for a 22x16x4 bearing held in the yaw_roll_motion body, coaxial with the head-yaw axis
interfaces.source: MEASURED off Pollen's mesh by cecad.meshfeatures (boss Ø16.00 len 1.9 at (0, 0, -11.05)), 2026-09-02

interfaces.name: pitch_horn_right
interfaces.what: side plate horn pattern: Ø6 centre + 4 x Ø2.2 on a Ø12 bolt circle — one side takes the head-pitch XL330's horn, the other its idler (the mesh is x-symmetric; which side is horn is an assembly choice)
interfaces.source: MEASURED off Pollen's mesh by cecad.meshfeatures (Ø6 len 3.0 + 4 x Ø2.2 len 3.0 at x 16, residual 0.000), 2026-09-02

interfaces.name: pitch_horn_left
interfaces.what: mirror of pitch_horn_right on the -x side plate — same Ø6 + 4 x Ø2.2 pattern
interfaces.source: MEASURED off Pollen's mesh by cecad.meshfeatures, 2026-09-02
